class SharedBase {
  protected static value = 1;
  protected static read() { return this.value; }
}
class SharedChild extends SharedBase {
  show(): number { return SharedBase.value + SharedBase.read(); }
}
class SharedGrandchild extends SharedChild {
  show(): number { return SharedBase.value + SharedChild.value + SharedBase.read(); }
}
console.log(new SharedChild().show(), new SharedGrandchild().show());
